description: The frozen P0 execution sequence as data. Dependencies, gates and calendar classes are transcribed from 00 §35; every empirical gate state is UNRESOLVED here, because no P0 outcome has been opened. The stage machine reads this document; it encodes no branching of its own [AUTH: 00 §35].

calendar.note: 00 §34C.1A: CALENDAR_COMPRESSED_MVRS automatically defers P0-C2, P0-D and P0-E unless one is needed to repair an MVRS validity problem. The deadline is planning metadata: wall clock alone never executes or skips a scientific cell. 00 §42: a missed deadline records P1 = NOT_STARTED_CALENDAR.

stages.title: Scoring-engine and analysis dry run
stages.note: 00 §35: no empirical P0 result may be opened before this passes.

stages.title: Compute benchmark and reference caching
stages.gate: P0_00_COMPUTE_BUDGET frozen; fixed theta_0 reference outputs cached once

stages.title: Blind split / deduplication leakage check
stages.note: 00 §35: an initial statistical flag triggers BLIND_SPLIT_INVESTIGATION, not an immediate stop. STOP_NATURAL_PRIVACY_ARM applies only after the confirmed §6.4 failure rule.

stages.title: Oracle privacy power and canary-load control
stages.note: 00 §35: STOP_PRIVACY_GRID only if BOTH the canary and natural arms are ineligible.

stages.title: Linear oracle plumbing
stages.note: 00 §35: known partner and known coefficient. Failure stops the recovery pipeline for debugging.

stages.title: Synthetic fidelity ladders
stages.gate: 00 §28A primary rank-matched and secondary full-rank isotropic ladders
stages.note: 00 §35: run immediately after P0-C1 passes, before the operator grid.

stages.title: Occupied common-source baseline
stages.gate: published-style baseline must outperform the naive shared mean; k in {2,4}
stages.note: 00 §34C.1A defers this under CALENDAR_COMPRESSED_MVRS unless it is required for an already-authorized early P1 launch. 00 §36: the known-varying-alpha lineage is activated only after this fixed baseline is reproduced.

stages.title: O3 SVD-TRUNC-MERGE fallback gate
stages.note: 00 §35: run only if DARE fails, unless O3 was separately budgeted as a pre-result secondary control. If O3 also fails, apply §24A.7.

stages.title: Conditional O3 spectral-truncation ladder
stages.note: 00 §35: eligible only once O3 is the selected primary lossy operator.

stages.title: O3 incomplete-lineage recovery validation
stages.note: 00 §25, §36: C14/C15/C17/C18 become RUN_REPRODUCTION only when O3 is selected AND this passes.

stages.title: Derivative-parent deployment scan
stages.note: 00 §34C.1A: deferred under CALENDAR_COMPRESSED_MVRS; may run in parallel only if it does not threaten P1/MVRS evidence.
